hook: Modulating a magnetic field makes polaritons emit photon pairs, not undergo a superradiant transition.
summary: Earlier predictions said modulating the magnetic field could drive a superradiant transition in Landau polaritons. An exact theory including the Faraday-induced electric field shows the system stays stable above a Krein frequency and below it emits pairs through the dynamical Casimir effect, with up to 5 to 10 dB of squeezing. The conclusion comes from theory and does not report an experiment.
title: Dynamical Casimir emission from Floquet-driven Landau polaritons: Gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition
